title: Understanding your CloudDash invoice
content:
## Invoice structure

Each monthly invoice contains the following sections:

### Base subscription
The flat monthly fee for your plan (Starter $29, Pro $99, Enterprise per contract).

### Add-ons
Optional paid features billed separately:
- **Extended retention** — additional metric history beyond plan default
- **Extra seats** — team members above plan limit (Pro only: $8/seat/month)
- **Priority support upgrade** — upgrading support tier without changing plan

### Prorated adjustments
If you upgraded or downgraded mid-cycle, a prorated credit or charge appears here.

### Taxes
VAT or sales tax based on your billing address. US customers may see state tax. EU customers see VAT.

### Payment methods accepted
- Credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex)
- ACH bank transfer (US, Enterprise plans only)
- Wire transfer (Enterprise plans only)
- No PayPal, crypto, or prepaid cards

## Downloading invoices
1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Invoice History**.
2. Click any invoice to download as PDF.

## Invoice disputes
To dispute a charge:
1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Invoice History**.
2. Click the invoice and select **Dispute Charge**.
3. Describe the issue and submit.
Our billing team responds within 2 business days.

## Failed payments
If a payment fails, CloudDash retries after 3 days, then 7 days. After two failed retries, your account is downgraded to read-only until payment is resolved.
